_schema: One record per finished sub-agent. Fields: ts (ISO), project (slug), role (agent type), tokens (exact total from the completion notification), model, agent_id, note. Tier-ratio learning-loop fields (developer-family runs only, else null): task (backlog task/slice id), tier (junior|developer|senior|principal that ran it), attempt (1 = first try at this tier, 2 = same-tier retry after a FAIL; principal may exceed 2), outcome (pass|fail = Tester verdict on this run's deliverable; deferred = verification deferred to final QA; blocked = stopped by an environment problem, excluded from tier rates), escalated_from (junior|developer|senior when the task was bumped up after a lower tier failed both attempts). Escalation policy is retry-once-at-same-tier-then-escalate. Appended by scripts/log-delegation.js when the Producer relays a sub-agent result. This is the only durable record of delegated cost, because sub-agent transcripts are wiped after they finish. Lines whose project does not match are ignored by the reader.
